stories.title: “Ministers have run out of excuses”: Fflint Wrecsam MS reacts to Wales’ worst UK PISA showing
stories.summary: Nigel Williams MS has called for an overhaul of how Welsh pupils are taught reading, writing and maths after Wales recorded the lowest scores of any UK nation in the latest PISA international education rankings, published on Wednesday. stories.title: “Very difficult choices” ahead as Flintshire’s budget gap tops £27m
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has identified just over £10m of potential savings towards next year’s budget gap, but most of it is rated high risk to deliver, according to a report going before Cabinet on Tuesday, 15 September. stories.title: Mold Town Council seeks contractor for five-year Christmas lighting deal
stories.summary: Mold Town Council could spend up to £151,200 over the next five years on its Christmas lighting scheme. stories.title: Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru begins another review of Senedd constituencies
stories.summary: A review of the Senedd constituencies covering Flintshire has been launched by the body responsible for setting Wales’s political boundaries. The Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru published its Guide to the 2030 Review on Wednesday. The current Fflint Wrecsam and Clwyd constituencies, which between them cover Flintshire, were created ahead of this year’s Senedd election
